source='''def transform(grid):
    h = len(grid)
    w = len(grid[0])
    separator = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] != 0 for r in range(h)))
    left = [row[:separator] for row in grid]
    right = [row[separator + 1:] for row in grid]
    return [[2 if left[r][c] != 0 and right[r][c] != 0 else 0
             for c in range(len(left[0]))]
            for r in range(h)]
'''
task_file.write_text(source)
print(task_file, task_file.exists())
